rules.statement: The jurisdiction of the Court to entertain an action under section 247 should be determined by the value of the property seized, not solely by the amount of the decree.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not see why the amount of the writ should alone be taken into consideration as determining the question of jurisdiction. There are two things that must be considered in a matter of this kind, and they are so closely mixed up that they should not be separated I mean that both the value of the land and the amount of the writ are important factors which must decide the question of jurisdiction."
